summary: Bus is a brutal, cutthroat pickup-and-deliver game where the real battle is over turn order itself, since choosing certain actions first means executing them last, forcing constant bluffing about when to commit. It rewards players who can read the shifting passenger flows and route contention on the board far more than raw efficiency, making it one of the more mentally taxing Euros of its era.
praised: the clever inverted turn-order mechanic that turns action selection into a game of chicken
deep, tense player interaction over shared board space and routes
high replayability from the modular, ever-shifting city and passenger destinations
rewards careful planning and reading opponents over luck
criticised: steep rules overhead and long teach for new players
long playtime that can drag, especially with full player counts
punishing for newcomers playing against experienced players
out-of-print scarcity and high secondary market prices

interaction.kind: blocking and area denial via route/turn-order chicken

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: the winner is decided almost entirely by how many passengers you successfully deliver via your bus routes each round
